name: empty-content-success
doc: FANG-13: a STRUCTURALLY VALID provider response that carries no content at all is not an error anywhere in the stack. This is deliberately NOT the no-choices.json shape: an empty `choices` ARRAY is caught at openai.rs:753 and becomes LlmError::Parse, i.e. a failure. Here `choices[0].message.content` is the empty string with finish_reason=stop, which openai.rs:779 (`if !text.is_empty()`) drops on the floor, producing a CompletionResponse with an empty content vec and StopReason::EndTurn. Twelve steps, two per caller-facing surface `../FANG-13.sh` drives, because every empty turn costs exactly two calls: the one-shot retry at agent_loop.rs (iteration 0, `Empty response, retrying once`) burns the first and the empty-response exit is reached on the second. Steps 0-1 are the first REST turn and start with a tool_call, so the turn reaches the exit with tools already executed - the branch that used to answer '[Task completed - the agent executed tools but did not produce a text summary.]', i.e. the runtime asserting completion on a turn where the provider said nothing. Steps 2-3 are the second REST turn, no tools. Steps 4-11 are the same no-tool shape once each for /v1 non-streaming, the WebSocket, the /message/stream SSE and /v1 with stream:true. Run with --tools memory_store; driver ../FANG-13.sh.
